title: 第5章 努力肝经验就能变强第6章 勤耕不辍拳法突破
content_zh:
;;
洪元看了他一眼，见他眼神清澈，态度诚恳，便颔首道：“也罢，便与你分说一二。我辈武者，首重炼体，谓之炼体秘境。此秘境分四关，乃循序渐进之途。”
“第一关，炼皮。打熬皮肤筋膜，增强抗击打之力，使得皮膜坚韧，寻常拳脚难伤。”
“第二关，开筋。拉伸锻炼周身大筋，使其柔韧，发力更为迅猛绵长。”
“第三关，锻骨。淬炼全身骨骼，使其致密坚硬，如铁似钢，承载更强力量，拳脚更具破坏力。”
“第四关，洗脏。滋养五脏六腑，增强内腑机能，气血旺盛，体力悠长，更能催发气劲，隔空伤人。”
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝精芒，语气也凝重不少：“若是达到炼体四关圆满，气血充盈至巅峰，便可尝试凝练气血，冲击炼血秘境。”
“一旦功成，气血如汞，奔流不息，无论力量速度，皆非炼体境可比，更能初步调动气血之力对敌。”
“但在清平县这等地方，一位洗脏境后期武师，已可横行一方，震慑宵小，便是开设武馆亦非难事。”
“我如今，便是处于洗脏境界，距离那一步不远。”
林青听得心驰神往。
仅仅只是洗脏武师，便能有开设武馆的实力，为县内数得上名号的高手。
更惶论，那炼血秘境。
武道之途，确实令人感觉心潮澎湃。
林青深深一揖：“多谢洪师傅指点，晚辈明白了。”
“阿雷，叫其他最近入门的弟子一并过来。”洪元招手。
“好嘞。”
有位肤色古铜，样貌敦厚的壮汉应答。
洪元将武馆内，最近一月新入门的弟子，都召集到练武场一侧。
算上林青，共有八人。

他们皆是二十岁以下的年轻面孔，神色均带着忐忑。
洪元负手立于众人之前，气势沉稳。
他目光扫过众人，声音洪亮：“既入我铁线拳门墙，当知根基之重，尤胜招式。”
“今日，便传尔等铁环桩功，此乃我铁线拳入门根基，亦是打熬下盘，凝炼气血之本。”
洪元亲自示范，双脚分开略宽于肩，膝盖微曲，身体缓缓下沉，直至大腿近乎与地面平行。
其双臂前伸于胸前，臂上还套着十来个沉重铁环，巍然不动。
林青看的心惊，一个铁环约莫五斤重，十来个便是五十来斤。
套在手臂上，普通人莫说伸直手臂，就连抬手都困难。
这位洪师傅，却能做到稳如泰山，当真厉害。
“看仔细了，此乃铁环桩，重心落于涌泉，沉肩坠肘，气沉丹田。”
“意念需存想于双臂铁环之上，呼吸自然，不可憋气。”
洪元的声音如同洪钟大吕，震响在每个人耳边。
他收势而立，让其他新入门弟子摆出姿势，而后继续解释，一一拨正其他弟子姿势。
林青也按照洪元方才的姿态站桩，双臂还套上了两个铁环，身上缠了几条铁线保持姿势。
不一会儿，他的身体就已经抖得不成样子。
但在铁线束缚下，他的动作依旧还保持着。
眼看其他弟子也在咬牙坚持，林青也咬紧牙关，不让自己泄气。
若不然，恐让其他人看笑话。
看到这些新入门弟子摆起架势，算是有模有样，洪元微微点头，继续开口。
“桩功看似不动，实则内里气血奔流，更有铁线束缚着筋肉震颤，是打熬筋骨，凝炼气血的无上法门。若下盘不稳，气血不旺，一切打法皆是空中楼阁。”

“从今日起，每日需站桩至少一个时辰，分次练习，循序渐进。初次练习者，仅需佩戴四个铁环即可。”
“张顺，接下来你盯着他们，顺便教下武馆的规矩。”
content_en:
;;
Hong Yuan glanced at him and saw that his eyes were clear and his attitude was sincere, so he nodded and said, "That's alright, I'll tell you about it. The first thing we, warriors, focus on is body training, which is called the Secret Realm of Body Refining. This secret realm is divided into four levels, which is a step-by-step approach."
"The first level is skin refining. The skin's fascia is strengthened to increase its resistance to blows, making the skin tough and difficult to be injured by ordinary punches and feet."
"The second level is to open the tendons. Stretch and exercise the big tendons throughout the body to make them flexible and to produce force faster and longer."
"The third level is bone forging. Tempering the bones of the whole body to make them dense and hard, like iron and steel, capable of carrying stronger strength, and the fists and feet can be more destructive."
"The fourth level is to wash the internal organs. It nourishes the internal organs and enhances the functions of the internal organs. The qi and blood are strong and the physical strength is long. It can also stimulate the qi energy to hurt people from a distance."
He paused, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and his tone became more solemn: "If you have reached the perfection of the four levels of body refining and your qi and blood are full to the peak, you can try to condense your qi and blood and attack the secret realm of blood refining."
"Once the skill is achieved, the energy and blood will flow like mercury, endlessly. Regardless of the strength and speed, it cannot be compared to the body refining realm. It can also initially mobilize the power of energy and blood to fight against the enemy."
"But in places like Qingping County, a martial artist in the late stage of the Cleansing Realm can already run rampant and intimidate Xiaoxiao. It is not difficult to open a martial arts gym."
"Right now, I am in the state of washing away the dirt, and I am not far from that step."
Lin Qing was fascinated by what he heard.
Just by washing the dirty martial arts master, he can have the strength to open a martial arts school and become one of the most famous masters in the county.
What’s even more worrying is the secret realm of blood refining.
The journey of martial arts is indeed exciting.
Lin Qing bowed deeply and said, "Thank you, Master Hong, for your guidance. This junior understands."
"Alei, ask the other disciples who have recently started to come over." Hong Yuan waved.
"Okay."
A strong man with bronze complexion and a strong appearance responded.
Hong Yuan summoned all the new disciples in the martial arts hall to one side of the training ground.
Counting Lin Qing, there were eight people in total.
They were all young faces under the age of twenty, and they all looked anxious.
Hong Yuan stood in front of everyone with his hands behind his back, his aura calm.
He glanced at everyone and said in a loud voice: "Now that you have entered the wall of my iron fist, you should know that the foundation is important, especially the moves."
"Today, I will teach you the Iron Ring Stake Kung Fu. This is the foundation of my Iron Wire Fist. It is also the basis for beating the lower body and condensing Qi and blood."
Hong Yuan personally demonstrated. He placed his feet slightly wider than shoulder width, bent his knees slightly, and slowly lowered his body until his thighs were almost parallel to the ground.
His arms were stretched forward in front of his chest, and there were about a dozen heavy iron rings on his arms, standing still.
Lin Qing was horrified to see that one iron ring weighed about five kilograms, and a dozen or so rings weighed more than fifty kilograms.
When it is put on the arm, it is difficult for ordinary people not to straighten the arm, but even to lift the hand.
This Master Hong can be as stable as a mountain, which is really amazing.
"Look carefully. This is an iron ring pile. The center of gravity is on the spring, the shoulders are sinking and the elbows are sinking, and the energy is sinking in the Dantian."
"Your thoughts need to be on the iron rings on your arms, and you should breathe naturally, and don't hold your breath."
Hong Yuan's voice was like Hong Zhong Da Lu, ringing in everyone's ears.
He stood up and asked the other new disciples to assume their postures, and then continued to explain, correcting the postures of the other disciples one by one.
Lin Qing also stood up according to Hong Yuan's posture just now, with two iron rings on his arms and several iron wires wrapped around his body to maintain his posture.
After a while, his body was shaking badly.
But restrained by the iron wire, he still maintained his movements.
Seeing that the other disciples were gritting their teeth and persisting, Lin Qing also gritted his teeth to prevent himself from being discouraged.
Otherwise, others may laugh at you.
Seeing these new disciples posing in a decent manner, Hong Yuan nodded slightly and continued to speak.
"The Zhuang Kung Fu seems to be motionless, but in fact, the energy and blood are flowing inside, and the iron wires bind the muscles and tremble. It is the supreme method to strengthen the muscles and bones and condense the energy and blood. If the lower body is unstable and the energy and blood are not strong, all fighting methods will be castles in the air.""From today onwards, you need to stand for at least an hour every day, practicing in batches, step by step. First-time practitioners only need to wear four iron rings."
"Zhang Shun, keep an eye on them and teach them the rules of the martial arts school."
